issues.description: Method naming mismatch for the static delivery-accepting method on SealSaloon: the problem statement defines a static method acceptSupplyDelivery(String, int, int) (problem_statement.md line 30) and the template Main calls shop.acceptSupplyDelivery(...) (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java line 20), but the solution implementation declares public static void receiveDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity) in src/de/tum/cit/ase/SealSaloon.java (line 47). This inconsistent method name for the same conceptual operation will cause students' implementations or automated tests that expect acceptSupplyDelivery to fail to compile or run and creates confusion about the required API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the API name consistent. Prefer renaming the solution method receiveDelivery to acceptSupplyDelivery with the same signature (public static void acceptSupplyDelivery(String name, int price, int quantity)). If renaming is not desired, add a public static acceptSupplyDelivery method that delegates to the existing receiveDelivery to preserve backward compatibility, and update the solution repository and any documentation accordingly. Alternatively, if deliberate, update the problem statement and template to require receiveDelivery instead of acceptSupplyDelivery (less recommended).
